clips.speaker: dispatch
clips.text: B1016, are you on scene?
clips.source: B1016，到场没有？
clips.direction: Cold check-in, a clipped question with no personal interest.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: I’m here.
clips.source: 到了。
clips.direction: Short, tired acknowledgement. No enthusiasm.

clips.speaker: dispatch
clips.text: A simple accident. File it and move. Two more on the north bank.
clips.source: 一场简单事故。核完赶紧交单，北岸还有两件。
clips.direction: Dismiss the incident. Cut off each instruction; impatient, emotionally uninvolved.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: Check the impact first.
clips.source: 先看撞哪儿了。
clips.direction: To himself, after putting the terminal away. Short, ready to work.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: The whole front end is crushed in.
clips.source: 车头都压进去了。
clips.direction: Observe the damage plainly.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: It did not graze the barrier. It went straight at it.
clips.source: 不是擦过去，是对着护栏冲的。
clips.direction: Trace the impact path to himself.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: These pieces all came off the front end.
clips.source: 这几块都是车头掉的。
clips.direction: Identify the debris without drama.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: Build Blackdream. See what happened.
clips.source: 构建黑梦，看看发生了什么。
clips.direction: A quiet decision to himself after the last scene clue. Not a tutorial.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: Yellow paint. This car is not yellow.
clips.source: 黄漆。这辆车可不是黄的。
clips.direction: Notice the mismatch; restrained curiosity.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: There are tracks from another car too.
clips.source: 还有另一辆车的痕迹。
clips.direction: Notice the second set of tracks without jumping to a conclusion.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: Yellow trim too. The paint matches.
clips.source: 饰条也是黄的，漆对得上。
clips.direction: Confirm the connection plainly.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: Add the yellow car. Run it again.
clips.source: 把黄车加进去，再放一遍。
clips.direction: A practical next step to himself.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: The collision produced new data.
clips.source: 碰撞时产生了新数据。
clips.direction: Notice the new record without raising his voice.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: Right here. That is when control was taken.
clips.source: 就在这儿，控制权被夺过去了。
clips.direction: Pinpoint the takeover without raising his voice.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: This car is no longer under control.
clips.source: 这辆车，已经不受控制了。
clips.direction: Let the implication settle between the two beats.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: Lu Shicheng. Chengyue.
clips.source: 陆世承，承岳的人。
clips.direction: Name the person and the group, then stop.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: Cheng Xu was an audit engineer at Meridian? He was using this port just before the crash.
clips.source: 程叙是经纬的审计工程师？出事前还在用这个接口。
clips.direction: Register his profession and the recent port access as a concrete lead.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: A temporary grant?
clips.source: 临时给的？
clips.direction: Question the new evidence, not a shocked outburst.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: 0.38 seconds early. The car had not turned yet.
clips.source: 早了 0.38 秒。那时候车还没转。
clips.direction: Read the timing precisely; contained unease.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: The wheel is turning now.
clips.source: 轮子现在就转向了。
clips.direction: Watching the replay. The turn is happening at this moment. Keep it short.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: Looks like there was a collision.
clips.source: 像是发生了碰撞。
clips.direction: A tentative working theory, not a solution.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: Check the body for other impact marks.
clips.source: 看看车身，有没有别的碰痕。
clips.direction: A practical instruction to himself, not a tutorial voice.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: The wheel moved first.
clips.source: 轮子先动的。
clips.direction: A small realization. Let first land.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: The yellow car had not touched it yet.
clips.source: 那时候黄车还没碰到它。
clips.direction: Questioning the causal chain, not expressing shock.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: You said the scrape made it turn. But the tire marks curve before the contact point.
clips.source: 你说刮擦让它转向。可胎痕在刮擦点之前就弯了。
clips.direction: Challenge the lie. Frustration builds; stress BEFORE, then leave a pointed silence.

clips.speaker: device
clips.text: Contact may have affected the assessed trajectory.
clips.source: 接触可能影响了判断轨迹。
clips.direction: Synthetic corporate reassurance. Deliberate, precise, calmly evasive with an artificial falling cadence.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: May have?
clips.source: 可能？
clips.direction: A sharp incredulous echo, containing anger rather than an innocent question.

clips.speaker: dispatch
clips.text: B1016, the hit-and-run is with Pursuit. You can close this.
clips.source: B1016，逃逸案已经转追查科了。你这单可以结了。
clips.direction: Cold administrative pressure. This is a dismissal, not permission or reassurance.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: Give me ten more minutes.
clips.source: 再给我十分钟。
clips.direction: A firm, economical request. No pleading.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: The right door is bent out. Should pry open. Check the service port.
clips.source: 右门翘着，应该撬得开，查看下检修接口。
clips.direction: Work through the next action to himself; stay conversational.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: It was not a manual input. The wheel was forced.
clips.source: 不是他手动操作，是被强制转向了。
clips.direction: A sickening realization. Breath catches before FORCED; disbelief hardens into anger.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: Zero Priority... a talisman for the rich.
clips.source: 零号保障...有钱人的护身符。
clips.direction: Understated, bitter irony. No relief or theatrical sarcasm.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: Why are the raw records locked?
clips.source: 原始记录为什么锁着？
clips.direction: Question the lock itself, not a theory he already knows.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: I want to see the port log.
clips.source: 我要看接口日志。
clips.direction: Firm demand with rising frustration. No pleading; he refuses to be brushed off.

clips.speaker: device
clips.text: Current permissions are insufficient.
clips.source: 当前权限不足。
clips.direction: An immaculate synthetic denial. Faint superior politeness; absolute finality, no human apology.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: My clearance is not enough. What about Cheng Xu’s?
clips.source: 我的权限不够，程叙的呢？
clips.direction: Recall the audit engineer’s credential as a possibility, not a guaranteed solution.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: It was still in use two minutes before the crash. Look in the car for the root key.
clips.source: 事故前2分钟还在使用，去车里找找根钥。
clips.direction: A practical next step to himself.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: Cheng Xu’s root key. Procedure says turn it in.
clips.source: 程叙的根钥。按规定应该上交。
clips.direction: An old rule he already knows he will break.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: I’ll borrow it.
clips.source: 先借用一下。
clips.direction: A trace of wry humor; no chuckle or comic punchline.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: Why was Zero Priority added temporarily?
clips.source: 为什么临时添加了零号保障？
clips.direction: The anger is now personal. Demand the hidden reason, rough breath, hold back from shouting.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: That is when Zero Priority was added.
clips.source: 这时候才添加了零号保障。
clips.direction: Pinpoint the moment; firm but not shouted.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: He tried to cancel the lane change. The system refused.
clips.source: 他想取消变道。系统没让。
clips.direction: Recognize that the apparent perpetrator was also being controlled.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: Just because he looked at the raw records?
clips.source: 就因为他查看了原始记录？
clips.direction: Horrified accusation. A man has been killed for looking; let the human cost break through.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: I need to take this back.
clips.source: 得把这些带回去。
clips.direction: Urgent resolve with fear underneath. A quick breath, then the decision to move.

clips.speaker: dispatch
clips.text: Received. Privilege dispute goes to Review. Jingwei and Chengyue will send someone.
clips.source: 收到。特权争议转审查科，经纬和承岳那边会有人对接。
clips.direction: Cold bureaucratic handoff; names are just another case number.

clips.speaker: dispatch
clips.text: B1016, you can close this.
clips.source: B1016，这单你可以结了。
clips.direction: Curt, final dismissal. No relief or friendliness.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: Understood.
clips.source: 知道了。
clips.direction: Resigned, not satisfied. The doubt has not disappeared.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: Someone will argue about the privilege.
clips.source: 特权会有人去吵。
clips.direction: Rationalizing his decision to leave.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: As for when Zero Priority took effect —
clips.source: 至于零号保障是什么时候生效的——
clips.direction: An unfinished thought he chooses not to pursue.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: That is no longer my file.
clips.source: 那不是我的单子了。
clips.direction: Self-dismissal, not a triumphant closing line.

clips.speaker: dispatch
clips.text: Received. The other vehicle goes to Pursuit.
clips.source: 收到。肇事车辆转追查科。
clips.direction: Flat procedural confirmation, no concern for the victim.

clips.speaker: dispatch
clips.text: B1016, two more on the north bank. Don’t linger.
clips.source: B1016，北岸还有两件，路上别耽误。
clips.direction: Impatient instruction. Stress DONT LINGER with restrained irritation.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: Understood.
clips.source: 知道了。
clips.direction: Dismissing a doubt to get through the shift.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: Someone will chase the yellow car.
clips.source: 黄车会有人去追。
clips.direction: A practical excuse to stop looking.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: Why it turned first —
clips.source: 至于它为什么先转了方向——
clips.direction: Leave the contradiction hanging.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: That is no longer my file.
clips.source: 那不是我的单子了。
clips.direction: Self-dismissal, not a triumphant closing line.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: Wait. The front wheel.
clips.source: 等等，前轮。
clips.direction: A sudden discovery interrupts his thought. Alert, intrigued.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: Rewind and look again.
clips.source: 倒回 {time}，再看一遍。
clips.direction: Quiet urgency; he needs to verify what he just saw.

clips.speaker: chen
clips.text: Aah! Ugh...
clips.source: [撞击痛呼]
clips.direction: Immediate involuntary cry as a car strikes him, followed by a short collapsing, winded groan. Raw shock and agony, no spoken words, no battle cry, no theatrical prolonged screaming.
